checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Recognizable F-35 configuration: one exhaust, two canted tails, no canards
must.why: Jet looks like an F/A-18/F-16 hybrid with a pointed nose, long wing roots and apparently two engines/exhausts in the rear views. It is not clearly an F-35.

must.item: Takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off
must.why: No runway or takeoff appears. It is all airborne over mountains.

must.item: Same aircraft design stays consistent between runway and airborne views
must.why: No runway view exists. The airborne design also shifts between frames, for example the tail shape and the exhaust.

must.item: All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible
must.why: No text overlays appear in any frame.

must.item: Audible English narration describing one engine and conventional runway takeoff correctly
must.why: Audio was not transcribed. The visuals do not show a runway takeoff, so it is unlikely to match.

faults.what: Aircraft is not an accurate F-35. It has a pointed nose, F-18-like tails and apparently twin engines.
No runway takeoff, which was the key scene requested.
Fictional red tail markings and a design that shifts between frames.
Low 480p resolution and a softer look.

summary: The clip is a nice-looking cinematic flight of a fighter jet over mountains, but the jet is not a convincing F-35, and it has no runway takeoff and none of the three required labels.
